queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior a
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
),
s AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share
  FROM g
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS baseline FROM s
)
SELECT s.ordertypedist, s.cnt AS count, s.share, s.share - b.baseline AS share_minus_baseline
FROM s, b
WHERE s.share > b.baseline;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) AS total_transactions FROM transactionrecord;
